findings: Multiselect visibleFiles rebuilt from directoryFiles/categoryFilesList/favoritesList via generic sortFileList, not actual recursive search result/selected album/favorites tab. SelectAll can omit displayed nested search matches and include files outside displayed album/tab. DeselectAll only removes this rebuilt subset, leaving other selections. Actual operation uses selectedFiles, making selection-scope discrepancy material. No file action executed.

Album action files come from albumFiles/audioAlbumFiles helpers based on known category list and exact parent; not directory recursive enumeration. Action count therefore category snapshot subset, not all filesystem children. Shared lock-sensitive image album actions disabled when albumCanAccess false; source gating present.

Paste Here button directly invokes pasteFiles when target exists in navigation state, without name-conflict confirmation or busy flag in this panel. Combined with v73 helper overwrite/delete-before-move concern now has UI callpath. Concurrent repeated clicks possible before coroutine clipboard clearing; no reproduction.

Delete confirmation Move to Recycle Bin explicitly present at5750-5793 for staged snapshot; narrows previous pending confirmation audit. User approves item name/count, then performDelete. Do not label normal local deletion unconfirmed.

Compression dialog takes archive name and checks nonempty only, then directly compressFiles; no existing-destination confirmation in caller. Folder/create/rename dialogs similarly check nonempty, dismiss irrespective operation outcome. Album rename helpers trimblank, ordinary rename does not.

Batch progress dialog shown for deletion/favorites; actual dialog cancellation/blocking definition later unread. Paste/compression code does not set batchFileProgress in reviewed helpers, so progressdialog cannot be assumed to prevent repeated paste/compress.

Image album copy/share/delete/compress operate filesInAlbum rather than directory itself; menu labels CopyAlbumPhotos/DeleteAlbumPhotos accurate subset intent. RenameAlbum renames directory, broader object than photo operations.

Image edited-save callback inserts saved file next to original into preview/directory/category/recent arrays if original present. No content verification, filesystem refresh, format inference, favorites mutation or searchresults update in callback. Duplicate insertion/generation consistency needs runtime.

Musiccollapsedbar bottom offset accounts imagealbum selection/multiselect/clipboard but omits selectedAudioAlbumForActions while floatingbar visibility includes it; potential overlap in audioalbum-selection state. No rendered validation.

PIN enable/change stores preference then announces outcome; disable/remove verify currentPIN source comparisons present. Biometric success callback gated. No broad app-lock bypass claim; storage policy/authentication runtime outside review.

Fullscreen image deletion stages general delete confirmation without clearingpreviewlist in callback. General delete reloads directory/category/recent/favorites but previewImageFiles remains separately held; actualviewer removal behavior later unread.
